title: cestichis compressa
intro: Cestichis compressa, commonly known as the Mountain Spoor or Mountain Pigeonwings, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various ailments such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues.
